title: Youth commission press release on child abuse reporting
summary: In July 2026 the youth commission voted 7 to 0 to move forward a revised press release about child abuse reporting training. In September a commissioner said it had gone to county communications, and the item stays on the agenda for status updates.

timeline.text: The press release item will stay on the agenda for a status update at the next meeting.
A commissioner said a press release about reporting was sent to the county communications team.

Motion on the revised press release about child abuse reporting training: The commission approved sending the revised press release forward, with the drafting commissioner able to work with the department's communications staff.
